permit.applies: The licensed employer, to the Ministry of Labour, on the approved form, on paper or electronically.
permit.first: The approvals and licences of the relevant regulatory authorities, a CV or employer's letter on the worker's expertise, an official recommendation where needed, and a medical examination recorded as fit before issue.

fees.what: Technical and Vocational Skills Development Commission, each permit issued or renewed

permit.eligibility: A non-Jordanian worker who practices a profession that is rare in terms of availability in the Jordanian labor market and contributes to the training and upskilling of Jordanian workers.

sources.title: Ministry of Labour (Jordan), The Principles for Issuing Work Permits for Non-Jordanian Workers with Specialized Skills for the Year 2024 (English)
sources.said: A non-Jordanian worker who practices a profession that is rare in terms of availability in the Jordanian labor market and contributes to the training and upskilling of Jordanian workers. … A. A work permit for a worker with specialized skills for one year. B. A work permit for a worker with specialized skills for six months. C. A work permit for a worker with specialized skills for three months. … The employer shall submit an application to the Ministry for the issuance of a work permit for a non-Jordanian worker with specialized skills for the first time, using the approved form either in paper or electronically, … The employer shall submit an application for renewing the work permit … An amount of (2150) two thousand one hundred and fifty Jordanian dinars for issuing a work permit for one year. … An amount of (1250) one thousand two hundred and fifty Jordanian dinars for issuing a work permit for six months. … An amount of (645) six hundred and forty-five Jordanian dinars for issuing a work permit for three months. … An additional amount of (50) fifty Jordanian dinars, allocated to Technical And Vocational Skills Development Commission,
